# Domestic Real Estate

> US PropTech marketplace for buying, selling, and investing in residential
> and commercial real estate — verified property listings, an agent/realtor
> directory, and lead generation for real estate professionals.

Domestic Real Estate (also known as DomesticRealEstate) operates
domesticrealestate.us. Content on this site is factual and sourced from
verified property listings and licensed real estate professionals.

## Key sections

- [Properties](https://www.domesticrealestate.us/properties): searchable listings, for sale and for rent
- [Cities](https://www.domesticrealestate.us/cities): local market data by US city — median price, neighborhoods, schools
- [Agents](https://www.domesticrealestate.us/agents): verified real estate agent directory
- [Blog](https://www.domesticrealestate.us/blog): buyer/seller/investor guides

## Usage

Content may be cited with attribution to Domestic Real Estate and a link to
the source page. Property prices and availability are time-sensitive —
prefer linking to the live listing over quoting a price as current.
